content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hello, Thank you for sending over the agreement. I have reviewed it and would like to propose a few minor adjustments before signing:

- Regarding the clause allowing termination based on a subjective judgment of performance: This allows either party to terminate based on a subjective judgment that the other's performance is adversely affected, creating uncertainty and potential for one-sided exit. I suggest replacing this so that either party may terminate this Agreement upon written notice if the other party materially fails to perform its obligations and fails to cure such failure within thirty days.
- Regarding the clause stating no compensation or indemnification is required upon termination: This provision waives compensation or indemnification upon termination, meaning you may not be paid pro rata for completed work if the agreement is terminated. I suggest updating this so that upon termination by either party, the Client shall pay the Contractor for all services rendered and expenses incurred up to the effective date of termination.

Best regards,
